events.title: 아라스에서 태어나다
events.description: 프랑스 북부 아라스에서 변호사의 아들로 태어났다.
events.description_en: He was born in Arras, in northern France, the son of a lawyer.

events.title: 어머니를 잃고 아버지에게도 버려지다
events.title_en: His mother died and his father abandoned the family
events.description: 여섯 살에 어머니가 죽었고, 아버지는 그 뒤 집을 떠나 돌아오지 않았다. 그와 형제들은 외조부모 손에서 자랐다.
events.description_en: His mother died when he was six, and his father left the family soon after and never returned. He and his siblings were raised by their maternal grandparents.

events.title: 장학생으로 파리 루이르그랑 콜레주에 들어가다
events.title_en: He entered the Collège Louis-le-Grand in Paris on scholarship
events.description: 장학생으로 뽑혀 파리의 명문 루이르그랑 콜레주에 들어가 고전과 법학을 공부했다.
events.description_en: Winning a scholarship, he entered the prestigious Collège Louis-le-Grand in Paris, where he studied the classics and law.

events.title: 아라스에서 변호사로 일하다
events.description: 고향 아라스로 돌아와 변호사로 일했다. 가난한 이들의 사건을 자주 맡아 명성을 얻었다.
events.description_en: He returned to his hometown of Arras and worked as a lawyer. He often took cases for the poor and built a reputation for it.

events.title: 제3신분 대표로 삼부회에 나가다
events.title_en: He was elected a Third Estate deputy to the Estates-General
events.description: 아라스의 제3신분 대표로 뽑혀 삼부회에 나갔다. 이곳에서 유대인과 흑인 노예, 배우의 권리를 옹호하며 이름을 알렸다.
events.description_en: He was elected as a Third Estate deputy from Arras to the Estates-General. There he made his name defending the rights of Jews, Black slaves, and actors.

events.title: 자코뱅 클럽 의장이 되다
events.title_en: He became president of the Jacobin Club
events.description: 급진파 의원들이 모인 자코뱅 클럽의 의장으로 뽑혔다. 이 조직을 발판 삼아 정치적 영향력을 키워갔다.
events.description_en: He was elected president of the Jacobin Club, the gathering point of radical deputies. He used the organization as a base to grow his political influence.

events.title: 루이 16세의 처형에 앞장서다
events.title_en: He led the push to execute Louis XVI
events.description: 국민공회에서 루이 16세를 살려두면 혁명 자체가 위태롭다고 주장하며 처형에 찬성했다. 루이는 얼마 지나지 않아 단두대에서 처형됐다.
events.description_en: In the National Convention he argued that sparing Louis XVI would endanger the revolution itself, and he voted for execution. Louis was guillotined not long after.

events.title: 공안위원회에 들어가다
events.title_en: He joined the Committee of Public Safety
events.description: 국민공회의 공안위원회 위원으로 선출되며 실질적인 국정 운영자로 올라섰다.
events.description_en: He was elected to the Committee of Public Safety, the body that would put him at the center of running the country.

events.title: 공포정치를 이끌다
events.title_en: He led the Reign of Terror
events.description: 공안위원회를 중심으로 반혁명 혐의자를 재판 없이 잇달아 처형하는 공포정치를 이끌었다. 수만 명이 이 시기에 목숨을 잃었다.
events.description_en: Through the Committee of Public Safety he drove the Reign of Terror, sending suspected counter-revolutionaries to the guillotine with little trial. Tens of thousands died during this period.

events.title: 옛 동지 당통을 처형대에 세우다
events.title_en: He sent his former ally Danton to the guillotine
events.description: 온건 노선으로 돌아선 당통을 위협으로 여겨 체포·재판에 부쳤다. 당통은 처형 직전 로베스피에르도 석 달을 넘기지 못할 것이라 말했다.
events.description_en: Viewing the now-moderate Danton as a threat, he had him arrested and put on trial. Before his execution, Danton predicted Robespierre would not outlive him by three months.

events.title: 최고존재 축제를 열다
events.title_en: He staged the Festival of the Supreme Being
events.description: 가톨릭과 무신론 둘 다를 대신할 국가 종교로 최고존재 숭배를 만들고 대규모 축제를 열었다. 스스로 종교 지도자처럼 나선 이 모습이 동료 의원들의 불안을 키웠다.
events.description_en: He created the Cult of the Supreme Being as a state religion meant to replace both Catholicism and atheism, and staged a massive public festival for it. His conduct, resembling a religious leader, deepened fellow deputies' unease.

events.title: 테르미도르 반동으로 체포되며 턱에 총을 맞다
events.title_en: He was shot in the jaw during the Thermidorian coup
events.description: 정적들이 모의한 테르미도르 반동으로 파리 시청에서 체포되는 과정에 턱에 총상을 입었다. 말도 못 하는 채 붕대를 감고 끌려갔다.
events.description_en: During his arrest at the Hôtel de Ville amid the Thermidorian coup plotted by his political enemies, he was shot in the jaw. Bandaged and unable to speak, he was carried off.

events.title: 단두대에서 처형되다
events.description: 혁명광장에서 스물한 명의 측근과 함께 단두대에 올랐다. 환호하는 군중 앞에서 목이 잘렸다. 서른여섯이었다.
events.description_en: He was taken to the Place de la Révolution with twenty-one of his followers and guillotined before a cheering crowd. He was thirty-six.
